aggregate_rendering.method: Equal-weight geometric mean of ratios of eight median frame times; shaping excluded

new_regressions: Poisoned/reused atlas regions with an initial empty view, transparent gaps, multiple pages/encoders, a nested layer, and GPU snapshot: exact pixels against independent textures
8200 compact solid commands crossing the 4096-command recording/deferred-merge limits: exact per-pixel source-over result
validation.native_text_reference: Existing packed/unatlased Core Text oracle; hinting, AA, interpolation and shaping retained
validation.background_load: Background activity recorded as authorized. This chat ran no tests, builds, simulators or image processing during timing. Application basenames redacted in committed report; full distributions/load snapshots remain local.

macos_catalog.scope: Selected-page smoke coverage. Screenshot readbacks outside timing; not exhaustive catalog parity.

ios.capture_note: Initial 3-second-page run captured SpringBoard after the final app exit. Corrected run inherited SIMCTL_CHILD_FERROUI_SMOKE_EXIT_MS=45000, preserving the last page until capture; all four page screenshots were visually inspected. No source/binary changes.
ios.cleanup: Test apps uninstalled and owned simulator shut down; other simulators untouched
ios.scope: Simulator selected-page checks; not exhaustive catalog parity or physical iOS performance

published_path_policy: Checkout-relative paths and ~/ home placeholders; recorded measurements and artifact/source hashes are unchanged.
privacy_history_policy: Personal paths, background process names and local device identifiers are omitted. Source commit IDs from the superseded branch are redacted; content hashes and measurements are historical and predate the upstream rebase.
